_source.title: GRIN-Global apple (Malus) evaluation data: SOLSOLIDS and FRUIT.FIRMNESS.PSI descriptors
_source.authors: USDA-ARS Plant Genetic Resources Unit, Geneva NY (National Plant Germplasm System)
_source.where: USDA Malus collection, Plant Genetic Resources Unit, Geneva, New York, USA
_source.method: Descriptor SOLSOLIDS: percent soluble solids, average refractometer reading from 3 fruits at full maturity (APPLE.MORPHOLOGIC evaluations, 1995-2017, usually one season per accession). FRUIT.FIRMNESS.PSI: penetrometer firmness in pounds-force (recorded as 'psi'), 2008-2018, mostly wild/collected accessions. No acidity in these evaluations. GRIN SSC values outside 4.0-32.0 Brix (e.g. 1, 1.1, 730) were treated as data-entry errors and dropped. Here: mean of observations per accession, then mean over accessions of the same cultivar (n = accessions).
_source.ta_units: g/L malic acid (no TA in this source)
